title: Automate onboarding: Atlas-30B v1.0 metadata, perf profiles, and changelog generation
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds onboarding artifacts for Atlas-30B v1.0 and wires it into our perf profile and changelog automation. Motivation: make new model onboarding painless and reliable by generating consistent metadata, performance profiles, and release notes automatically from our test harness runs. What changed: 1) models/atlas-30b/metadata.json - canonical metadata including model_variant, tokenizer, quantization-recommendation, and compat matrix with serving runtimes. 2) perf/profiles/atlas-30b-v1.json - initial perf profiles generated from the perf-lab runs (latency P50/P95, throughput baseline, memory footprints) plus recommended batch/kvcache configs. 3) scripts/auto_changelog.py - extend automation to include model registry entries; it now parses perf profile artifacts and produces a changelog snippet ready for the registry and release notes. 4) ci/pipeline.yaml - new pipeline stage to kick off perf-suite and publish artifacts to the model-registry artifacts bucket. 5) docs/models/atlas-30b.md - user-facing summary and quickstart. 6) tests/perf/atlas_smoke_test.py - smoke test used to bootstrap perf profile generation. Backwards compatibility: metadata follows existing schema and includes optional fields for private deployments. Changelog automation: the script extracts perf deltas vs baseline models and will flag regressions as warnings in the PR checks. Checklist: [x] metadata schema populated, [x] perf profile generated from lab runs, [x] changelog snippet created, [x] CI stage added, [x] docs added, [x] unit + smoke tests. Impact: enables faster, lower-touch model onboards and reduces manual changelog drift. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and QA.
